annotations.text:
TERMINAL INDEX
IBM Plex Mono throughout (Plex Sans for article prose). Warm paper, warm near-black ink, one burnt-orange accent. Hairline rules and square corners instead of cards-with-radii.

Every screen has a working light/dark toggle in the header.

PROJECTS
The stack filter chips are live — click one. The whole index renders from a PROJECTS array; the chips rebuild themselves from each project's tech list, so adding a project is one object.

WRITING
One markdown file per post in posts/. Titles, hooks and dates are marked slots — nothing invented. The Article artboard next door is the type specimen for how the markdown renders.

390px
Same page at phone width. The menu button and theme toggle both work; every tap target is 44px or larger.
The two card components, with their states, thumbnail motifs, and the data shape each one reads from. Click the chips top-right of each sheet to switch state or variant.
